_comment: Sanitized fixture for FORMATS_BY_MEMBER_ID_QUERY (real operation name: FormatsByMemberId), called with withMember=true, withAlias=false -- the confirmed bridge from a member id to their per-league alias ids (see parser/apa_graphql.py's comment above FORMATS_BY_MEMBER_ID_QUERY for how this was confirmed with real ids against a live account). All ids invented except the shape, which matches the real capture: member.aliases is a list, one entry per league the member plays in, each with its own alias id and a formats list that can include more than one format for the same league.
